recipes.name: Roasted Lemon Turmeric Hummus
instructions: Optional step: preheat the oven to 475°F (250°C)*. Cut the lemon in half and place cut-side up on a lined baking tray. Bake for 10 minutes, then allow to cool.
Add the roasted lemon juice, along with all the remaining ingredients to a food processor and blend until smooth.
Taste test and adjust the seasoning to your liking. Plate, garnish, serve with crackers, cut-up vegetables, or enjoy in a wrap or sandwich.

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
